name: Mejoku ~Fukushuu Gakuen~
source:
Main character works as a teacher. Five female teachers make fun of him which turns into bullying. His stress reaches peak level and he attacks a student girl on the way back home from club. To his surprise, the girl continues to favor him after that. Together they devise a plan to crush five female teacher dominance.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-april-2004-realize.html]vndbreview[/url]]
